node.text: AccuWeather’s Bengaluru forecast shows cloudy or sunny-interval conditions through the next three days with the highest rain chance on Wednesday and continued shower/thunder/storm potential on Thursday and Friday.
Carry an umbrella or light rain jacket, especially for afternoon and evening plans.
Plan outdoor activities earlier in the day, when conditions are likely to stay drier and slightly cooler.
